accuracy.evidence: Checked CCSS 6.SP.5c MAD as average |value−mean| and KS3 measures of spread; worked 2,4,6 → mean 4 → MAD 4/3.

misconceptions.evidence: Checked traps: MAD=range; MAD=mean; signed deviations cancel; same mean forces same MAD.

lab_distinct.evidence: Checked flagmad: mean→|dev|→MAD compare; not flagspread (stat questions/range), flaghist (plots), flagsample.

lab_teaches.evidence: Checked: learner reveals mean, marks absolute deviations, averages into MAD, picks larger-MAD set, spots range myth, orders steps.

predictions.evidence: Checked tempting wrongs on first step, absolute value, MAD definition, same-mean myth, range mix-up, and step order.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Checked why() splits range/mean/same/sum mix-ups with named MAD slips.

readability.evidence: Checked ages 11–13 kid lines use mean / absolute deviation / MAD; adult names 6.SP.5c within learner bars.

no_filler.evidence: Checked every sentence teaches MAD steps, same-mean contrast, or a named mix-up — no throat-clearing.

mobile.evidence: Checked MAD controls with large lbtn twins and tap targets; layout holds near 390 px width.

accessibility.evidence: Checked mean/dev/MAD/compare buttons twin canvas taps; live aria-label narrates MAD; challenge uses aria-live status.
